measured_observations: Separate monotonic direction-specific transition brackets were measured: +0.44 return / +0.45 defect and -0.41 return / -0.42 defect.
At both boundary defect onsets the ball-joint twist limit still had substantial positive margin and engaged later.
At both boundary defect onsets the spin-joint reaction on the dominant-load corner had the outward steering sign; rack motor and dominant tie-rod moment opposed further steering.
The dominant-load contact centroid was farther forward (more negative positive-behind geometric trail) in the defect case than in the adjacent returning case at matched time.
interpretive_limits: Reaction/contact channels are not independent or directly additive; they describe transmission at different levels of the same dynamic system.
Geometric contact trail is an impulse-centroid diagnostic, not pneumatic trail or a tire constitutive model.
The observations localize a source signature but do not prove which collision/contact equation must change.
No shipping value, manual-feel acceptance, Windows parity, general-speed validity or fix is claimed.
